mapper.sql: select p.id, p.tenant_id as tenantId, t.company_name as tenantName, p.product_id as productId, p.product_code as productCode, p.product_name as productName, p.policy_no as policyNo, p.order_no as orderNo, p.agent_name as agentName, p.agent_user_id as agentUserId, p.agent_dept_id as agentDeptId, p.premium, p.amt, p.commission_status as commissionStatus, p.status, p.appnt_date as appntDate, p.accecpt_date as accecptDate, p.policy_invalid_date as policyInvalidDate, p.policy_start_date as policyStartDate, p.policy_end_date as policyEndDate, p.applicant_name as applicantName, p.applicant_sex as applicantSex, p.applicant_id_no as applicantIdNo, p.applicant_id_type as applicantIdType, p.applicant_mobile as applicantMobile, p.relationship_to_insured as relationshipToInsured, p.insured_name as insuredName, p.insured_sex as insuredSex, p.insured_id_no as insuredIdNo, p.insured_id_type as insuredIdType, p.insured_mobile as insuredMobile, p.del_flag as delFlag, p.version from biz_insurance_policy p left join sys_tenant t on t.tenant_id = p.tenant_id
